name: Steven
text: Had a great time with few friends , getting away for the weekend.

name: Devon
text: This home has it all and is close by to so many fun things to do!

name: Erica
text: Edward was a great host and very responsive before and during my stay

name: Jonathan
text:
Unforgetable experience for all of our group. The home was even better than we imagined and it was a dream stay. Edward was amazing throughout.
I cant recommend this place enough, 100/100!
Thank you Edward!

name: Sean
text: Great stay from start to finish! The place was very clean. The host communicated clearly and promptly throughout, from booking questions to check-in details, which made everything easy. Would happily recommend this place to friends and family, and we're already looking forward to booking again ourselves. 10/10!

name: Craig
text: Very cool house, amenities exactly what you want when booking this kind of home. We had a large group of childhood friends, wives and kids. Owner was very responsive and helpful.

name: Caitlin
text: Edward’s place in the mountains was the perfect backdrop to celebrate my husband’s 40th birthday with family and friends! We made good use of the amenities and had plenty of space with comfy beds for both kids and adults. We loved our time there and hope to return again!

name: Adam
text: Great host. Very responsive to issue that came up.

name: Goar
text: Great location ! Clean house ! Everything looks great and clean!

name: Rosaria
text: Our stay at Wiki Villa was great! We were a group of 22 with 14 adults and 8 kids varying from infant age to 14 and there was always plenty to do for everyone: pool table, ping pong table, pickleball, tennis, soccer, basketball, sauna, pool, hot tub and movie room. We also had 2 dogs with us. The pool was a bit cold for some of the kids so maybe a pool heater would be beneficial. Owner was always very responsive. I think anyway looking to get away from the nyc/nj hustle and bustle can come here for a quick getaway.

name: Sadie
text: Family had a great time visiting Edward’s place. Pictures were accurate and everything was as described.

name: Robin
text: The house was comfortable and the space accommodated our family gathering. It was spacious, clean, and the outdoor space had a lot of activities to do. The pool, hot tub, and tennis court were in great condition. We would highly recommend this house for a family gathering for all ages. Eddie was responsive and in touch throughout our time there. His instructions were clear and helpful.

name: Britney
text:
Our stay for our family reunion was tremendous and we can’t wait to return! The house had everything we needed and had no shortage of things to do for our large party with young children. The house is beautifully decorated, comfortable, clean, aesthetic, and so much fun to be in.
The area is so beautiful and very close (5-10 min drive) to beautiful hikes. We even had docile deer in the front yard often for the kids to admire.
From the pool, to the sauna, to the hot tub, tennis courts, and the fire pit for s’mores and lightning bugs in the evening, to the play structure and movie room, we had the best time. Thanks, Edward!

name: Sarah
text: Our group of 14 really enjoyed our stay at Wiki Villa. The ample space allowed 4 families to gather together but also offered places for kids and grown ups to hang out separately. We spent most of our time poolside and really enjoyed the awesome outdoor setup. We loved the character and charm the old house offered but appreciated the updated modern amenities. Some linens were dirty upon arrival and the backyard photos were a little deceiving. FYI for pet owners- The backyard isn't fully fenced and is overgrown in some areas but it didn't stop our crew from enjoying the space.

name: Fran
text: Edward’s house was great for our neighborhood reunion. We had about 15 adults and 5 kids and there was room enough for everyone. The real highlight for us was the backyard with a beautiful pool, hot tub, tennis/basketball/pickleball court, grill, fire pit, and a scenic creek. We even saw families of deer grazing in the woods beyond the creek. It was lovely!

name: Nick
text: Our stay was fantastic! Eddie was a fantastic host and very communicative. We had an absolutely amazing time and the house was in a beautiful location. 10/10 would rent again!

name: Darek
text: This place was amazing! Lots of room for all the guests, and plenty to do. The pool and hot tub is beautiful. This is a great place to host a large gathering with friends and family. There are restaurants and stores close by too. I would recommend this place anytime.

name: Kristen
text:
Fantastic place for a large family or multiple family’s to spend time together! So much to do! There are so many things to do that there is no reason to leave! The pool and sport court are amazing and so much fun! Loved the Sauna and pool table and air hockey and ping pong table etc..
They provide all the rackets and balls. The pool has a basket ball hoop for added fun! The huge kitchen table for eating and playing games together was perfect! We were able to bring our fur babies and that is a must for us!! This home is so roomy and the beds were comfortable and we had such a great time! I highly recommend this home and wood stay here again!!! The only downside was our stay was too short!

name: India
text: This Airbnb was an absolute dream and the perfect place to host my 21 friends and me for my birthday weekend. Edward was an outstanding host - always very responsive and accommodating. I would book this place again in a heartbeat and only wish we'd had more time there!

name: Cesar
text: We had a great stay! The house was spacious, clean, and had plenty of amenities to keep our group entertained. Eddie was responsive, helpful, and made the check-in process smooth. We’d definitely recommend this place for larger groups and would stay here again.

name: James
text: Great stay, excellent house with lots of space in a great peaceful location. Pool / hot tub are great too! We did wish some more towels were provided (they only provide one per person) and we found the kitchen a bit underequipped but the host mentioned they would be working to improve that for future guests.

name: Hariklia
text: The house was beautiful and there was so much to do in the house. Overall great time I had such a fun experience with my party.

name: Kayleigh
text:
We had an amazing stay! Our group of 13 fit comfortably with plenty of space for everyone. The bedrooms were large, the bathrooms were spacious and the house was incredibly well equipped with multiple refrigerators, washers, and dryers.

I originally booked because Eddie mentioned he was installing a pool and redoing the backyard. Not only did he deliver on everything he promised, but the upgrades exceeded my expectations. The pool was beautiful, spacious, and a fantastic addition to an already great property.

The outdoor space was perfect, especially the fire pit area with plenty of seating for our whole group. Inside, the decor was stunning, the wallpaper, colors and unique design touches made the home feel special and memorable.

Eddie was responsive, accommodating, and true to his word throughout the entire process. We couldn’t have asked for a better host and would absolutely stay here again! Highly recommend.

name: Justin
text: Was a great property and had lots of great activities!

name: Enmanuel
text: Beautifully decorated home. Lots of space to hold a group. Sauna is a nice amenity.

name: Sumon
text:
We do a family trip to the Poconos every year, and this was hands down the best place we’ve stayed. Even with a few rainy days, the house had so many amenities that the kids stayed entertained the whole time.

Beautiful aesthetics, tons of space, and excellent communication from the host. We’d absolutely stay here again!

name: Leah
text: We had a great experience at this beautiful home. The host was very responsive and clear with expectations and check-in. There was so much to do and everyone had a great time. Thank you for extending your home and hospitality to us!

name: Stephanie
text: The house was so amazing and above and beyond what the pictures even show! The amenities were great for hosting a large group and kept everyone entertained all weekend long without even having to leave the house. Edward was a great communicator leading up to the trip and during. I would highly recommend this location for planning getaways with large groups! So much space for everyone.

name: Taylor
text: Beautiful house with amazing amenities! Edward was very easy to reach when needed.

name: Frances
text: Eddie was a wonderful host!! His home was home away from home for us. We travel using ABNB’s all the time. This was by far one of the greatest! There were plenty of rooms and beds, house was clean, upgraded and seems to be newly renovated. The home is Beautiful!! This house was well stocked with everything, we enjoyed our stay so much. We didn’t want to leave, we’re already planning our next stay. This experience was the most memorable we’ve ever had with an ABNB. The amenities were too many to remember because we were having so much fun!! This house has a game room, pool table, sauna, tennis court, basketball court, jacuzzi and a complete movie room with mini gulf in front. The decor is amazing and peaceful, detail in every room. They literally thought of every need to make vacation an amazing experience!! Thank you so much Eddie!!

name: Sergio
text: Wonderful Place! My family and I absolutely loved the stay there! Can’t wait to rebook

name: Maggie
text: We spent the weekend here to celebrate my partner’s 30th and it was the perfect place to do so! The location is super nice - you’re only 5 minutes away from the local town and the house is beautiful! Each bedroom is filled with so much natural light and there are a good amount of bathrooms available. We especially loved the kitchen and the movie theater room. The beds were incredibly comfortable and there were many places to relax and lounge.

name: Sandra
text:
We stayed at Eduards beautiful place while having a small family reunion. Everyone loved the house, amenities and space. With a big family, you can sometimes feel crowded but not here. We all had tons of privacy, as well as, of things to do in and around the house!

Would stay again!

name: Brittany
text: Awesome house for family trip!!! Pictures did no justice . This house was huge and had lots of things to occupy the whole family! Great host responded quickly!

name: Kürşat
text:
Eddie was an absolutely fantastic host easy-going, communicative, and made the whole experience seamless from start to finish. Highly recommend!

Wiki Cabin itself has so much to offer. (Kitchen was so specious big ciunter space we had lots off fun cooking) The house is spacious with multiple king bed rooms and the communal areas are really thoughtfully laid out perfect for a group stay. You can tell a lot of care has gone into making it comfortable for everyone.

The location is a big plus too. If you're planning a ski trip or want to hit the mountain, you couldn't ask for a better base. We'll definitely be back!

name: Chris
text: Great stay! The place was clean, exactly as described, and in a great location. The host was responsive and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. Would definitely stay again.

name: Laura
text: Great house. Super roomy, cozy, and had lots to do. Lots of outdoors activities nearby. Such a gem!

name: Celea
text: My group & I had a great time at Eddie's place. We ran into a few issues along the way and Eddie was very responsive and helpful in all areas that he could be. We enjoyed the house so much, it was perfect for the size of our group. Overall, Eddie was a great host and the house was beautiful!

name: Hindy
text: Even more beautiful than in the photos, perfect for large groups and very responsive host. Would love to come back!

name: Soli
text:
Great stay, will definitely book with Edward again. He’s very responsive and an amazing host. The house we stayed in was very clean and very convenient being 1 minute from the ski mountain.

10/10

name: Nancy
text:
We had a big group stay for the weekend as we were taking the kids to kalahari and celebrating my birthday! We loved being able to come back to the house to relax and play games and the house was big enough for everyone to have their own private rooms.
We enjoyed the hot tub and the sauna which was really big! The kids loved having a big house to play in and the adults enjoyed the pool table and large dining table for game space. There were plenty of bathrooms throughout the house and the heaters worked great. Kitchen was very nice but lacking in oven baking trays but otherwise it was very big and roomy, lots of counter space and a huge pantry. We loved the open space floor plan.
There are lots of stairs to go up but we had no issues and enjoyed the multi level home. Rooms are very spacious.
There were lots of restaurants around and we were able to get delivery a few times with no problems! Great communication & overall we had a great stay and would recommend!
Thank you Edward!

name: Eeona
text: The home is absolutely beautiful and very spacious! The kitchen is very large and fully equipped. The home is also extremely close to Shawnee Mountain where there’s skiing, snowboarding and snow tubing. I recommend that you call or go online to book as they sell out quickly. We weren’t able to visit Shawnee mountain due to them being sold out. However, we were able to snow tube at white lightening snow tubing which was only 10 minutes away from the house. Aside from that, we stayed in the home for majority of our stay as there was plenty to do in the house. We were able to cook and grill so we didn’t need to order food or go out. The home truly had everything that we needed. Edward was very responsive. Any concerns that I had, he made sure to contact me with instructions. I would definitely recommend booking with Edward and I would stay at this home again. My family and I absolutely loved the home! This was my first time booking an Airbnb and I couldn’t have asked for a better host!

name: Fred
text: Good and peaceful location, very close to Ski Mountain. We had great time staying at this house. It had everything we needed. Edward was very thoughtful and was asking always if we need something and was very responsive. Definitely will be back again soon.

name: Rolando
text: Very nice recently remodeled home with lots of rooms for many people… very convenient if skiing on shawnee …may amenities and great host! We loved it

name: Michelle
text: We had a great stay at Edward’s place. The location was perfect, just minutes from Shawnee Mountain, which made our ski days incredibly easy. The house had plenty of space for our whole family to spread out and be comfortable, with room to relax and gather together. Everything was exactly what we needed for a family getaway, and we really enjoyed our time there.

name: Bria
text: Will book every time when in the area!! Simply amazing!

name: Arpit
text: Had an amazing time staying here. Eddie is very responsive and made sure we had all the information we needed to have a stress free trip. The home is amazing, especially the kitchen.

name: Daniel
text: Pictures did not do the house justice. Blew our expectations away in size and decor. Great amenities and lots to do just within the house. Much larger than I was expecting and extremely cozy. Hosted 9 guests easily with tons of beds and bathrooms. Perfect for a skiing weekend with the mountain just 5 minutes up the road. Had a wonderful time and already miss the house. Will definitely be back again. This house was one of the highlights of an already memorable trip. There really is no reason to leave it if you don’t want to. 10/10 would recommend if hosting a large gathering and getaway!

name: Ruby
text:
Our stay was memorable. The home has a unique charm with beautiful craftsmanship, high ceilings, and a thoughtful blend of historic character and modern updates. From the moment we arrived, it felt warm, inviting, and well cared for.

The bedrooms were spacious and comfortable, with supportive beds and high-quality linens. The layout gave our group both privacy and shared space. The amenities were a highlight — the sauna and hot tub were perfect for relaxing, the movie room became a favorite hangout, and the double-range kitchen made cooking for a large group easy.

The outdoor space was peaceful, with a pond, stream, grill, and plenty of seating. The private tennis court was a great bonus and kept everyone entertained.

The location was ideal: one minute from Shawnee Mountain and about ten minutes from Bushkill Falls and the Delaware Water Gap.

Overall, the home was comfortable, well maintained, and thoughtfully designed. It felt truly luxurious, and we’d gladly stay again.
